title: This cholesterol drug promised to be a game-changer. Why did it flop in the clinic — and is there still hope?
title_zh: 这种降胆固醇药物曾被视为游戏规则改变者。为何它在临床中失败——还有希望吗？
abstract: Physicians were excited about several therapies that slash levels of lipoprotein(a) — an important cardiovascular risk factor. One major trial failed to show a benefit, and now scientists are scrambling to work out what that means.
abstract_zh: 医生们曾对几种能显著降低脂蛋白(a)水平的疗法感到兴奋，脂蛋白(a)是重要的心血管风险因素。一项重大试验未能证明获益，现在科学家们正竭力弄清这一结果意味着什么。
